# Recreation Prompt

Build a single-file browser game called **Giant Claybot: Forge Oath**. Preserve the mechanics of a mobile interactive episode: a start gate begins a six-scene sequence; each of the first five scenes ends in a two-button choice; either choice advances; progress dots mark current/completed scenes; pause/resume works only during active timed scenes; the sixth scene leads to a completion overlay with replay. Rebuild presentation as a deterministic claymation world with a giant robot warrior, handmade clay textures, cyan core glow, forge-orange UI, cardboard skyline, gears, tin drones, glowing shards, mobile-safe bottom choices, catalog-approved sci-fi audio, and compact GIF feedback. Use vanilla HTML/CSS/JS inline in `index.html`.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: mobile-first interactive video / visual-novel episode with timed scene playback and binary decisions.
- objective: advance through six sequential story scenes by tapping the start gate and making five two-option choices when each scene freezes.
- input model: click/tap start, click/tap one of two choice buttons, click/tap pause/resume, click/tap replay after completion.
- core loop: play a scene segment, freeze/stop for a decision, accept either branch as progression, flash feedback, advance to the next scene, update progress dots, repeat until terminal completion screen.
- fail/friction state: there is no branching loss state; friction comes from waiting for the next decision, pause/resume, and replay after the completed episode.

## Protected Mechanics
- Six-step sequential progression with five binary choice gates.
- Choices progress the episode regardless of which option is selected; choice count/status feedback updates.
- Progress indicator tracks current/completed scenes.
- Start gate unlocks the episode and audio lifecycle.
- Pause/resume is available during active scene playback and not during choice gates/end screen.
- End screen exposes replay by reloading the episode.

## Remix Blueprint
The remixed canonical surface is `index.html`: a deterministic procedural claymation interactive episode named **Giant Claybot: Forge Oath**. The original video drama is reinterpreted as six stop-motion forge frames starring a giant robot warrior. The playable truth remains the same scene-choice-scene chain, while video files are replaced by timed procedural scenes, animated clay textures, focal robot sculpture, sci-fi forge audio, GIF feedback, mobile HUD, and bottom-reachable choice buttons.
